sloka: विरुजौ राघवौ दृष्ट्वा ततो वानरयूथपाः ।सिंहनादांस्तदा नेदुर्लाङ्गूलान् दुधुवुस्तदा ।। ६.५०.६१ ।।।।
transliteration: virujau rāghavau dṛṣṭvā tato vānarayūthapāḥ ।siṁhanādāṁstadā nedurlāṅgūlān dudhuvustadā ।। 6.50.61 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the Vanara troops, seeing the Raghavas freed from anguish, roared like a lion, and lashed their tails.
